children: Peru's state-run oil company Petroperu secured a $475 million disbursement from international banks, a cash injection aimed at overcoming a financial and operational crisis, state investment agency Proinversion said on Tuesday.
The funds are part of a long-awaited financing package of up to $2 billion that was previously agreed upon by the company and the government, the agency added.
